sources.authority: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
facts: LIDAR Composite DTM 1m covers approximately 99 percent of England
DTM is produced from last or only laser returns and surface objects are removed
the composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
where repeat surveys exist the newest best-resolution data is used
resampled data uses bilinear interpolation before merging
survey dates represented in the 2022 composite range from 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022
metadata index catalogues identify which survey was used at a location

promotion_rule: Composite DTM may be primary terrain evidence only after coverage and location-specific survey lineage are known; change-sensitive parcels require timestamped cross-check.
